title: ARV Error
description: A typed error from any ARV tool or endpoint. Over HTTP it is the response body. Over MCP it is the structuredContent of a tool result with isError true.

arv.description: ARV version. Every ARV object carries "arv": "1.0".

anyOf.description: An origin-specific code under a reverse-domain prefix, for example com.example/quota_exceeded.

message.description: Plain text for a person or an agent. Not parsed.

moment_uri.description: arv:{asset_id}#t={start_ms},{end_ms}. The canonical snapped range is the moment's identity.

retry_after_ms.description: How long to wait before a retry. Required for rate_limited.

challenge_url.description: Where the user links an account or pays. Required for entitlement_required and payment_required.
